UPTYCS_TAG_FILTER.description: Optional comma-separated list of Uptycs asset tags that scopes the asset + alert pull. Sent to the Uptycs REST API as a URL-encoded JSON filter ({"tags":{"in":["tagA","tagB"]}}) so only matching assets are returned, and the subsequent alert pull is narrowed to the asset-id subset emitted by the assets call. Each token is stripped, validated against [A-Za-z0-9_.:/\-+= @] (control chars and commas inside a token rejected), and de-duped — malformed tokens are logged and skipped without failing the whole run. When blank no tag filter is applied and the executor walks the full asset + alert catalogue (use a tag for prod vs. staging scoping, owning-team scoping, or per-application slicing). Pagination is capped at PAGE_SIZE=100 per page x MAX_PAGES=200 = 20k rows per endpoint.

UPTYCS_MIN_SEVERITY.description: Optional client-side severity floor for Uptycs alerts. Accepts info | low | medium | high | critical (plus Uptycs-side synonyms: informational / debug -> info, notice / minor -> low, warning / moderate -> medium, important -> high, fatal / severe -> critical) plus numeric input bucketed via CVSS 0-10 (1-3.9 low, 4-6.9 medium, 7-8.9 high, 9-10 critical). Alerts below the floor are dropped from the Faraday output after per-row severity normalisation (bucketed from the freeform severity string with numeric score / severityScore fallback). Defaults to info (no filtering).

name: uptycs
title: Uptycs
description: Uptycs cloud workload / XDR importer. Pulls the monitored asset catalogue + open alert catalogue from an Uptycs tenant via the REST API and emits Faraday bulk-create JSON. Uptycs is asset-scoped (unlike Splunk / QRadar's search-scoped surfaces) — the platform maintains a per-endpoint inventory keyed by assetId (servers, workstations, containers, cloud workloads) so each Uptycs asset becomes one Faraday host record carrying the asset's hostname / IPs / OS string / tag catalogue, and each Uptycs alert is converted into a Faraday vulnerability with the engine prefix [SIEM]. Endpoints used: GET /public/api/customers/{cid}/assets (paginated asset catalogue, optionally narrowed by the UPTYCS_TAG_FILTER URL-encoded JSON filter shape {"tags":{"in":["tagA","tagB"]}}); GET /public/api/customers/{cid}/alerts (paginated alert catalogue — narrowed to the tag-scoped asset-id subset when UPTYCS_TAG_FILTER is set via {"assetId":{"in":[...]}}, otherwise pulled wholesale). Pagination is limit + offset cursor (PAGE_SIZE=100 per page capped at MAX_PAGES=200 = 20k rows per endpoint). Severity bucketed from Uptycs's freeform severity string enum (critical / high / medium / low / info — plus Uptycs synonyms informational / debug / warning / moderate / minor / notice / fatal / severe / important) with the numeric score / severityScore / severity_score (0-10 CVSS-style) used as a fallback. Status mapped from alertState / state / status (open / new / active / in_progress / pending -> open, resolved / closed / fixed / mitigated -> closed, suppressed / dismissed / ignored / false_positive / risk_accepted / waived -> risk-accepted). Refs include Uptycs-Alert / Uptycs-Asset / Uptycs-Rule / Uptycs-Code / Uptycs-Tag / Uptycs-Threat pivots plus inline URLs from references / advisory_urls / links fields. CVE list harvested via a strict CVE-\d{4}-\d+ regex from cve / cveId / cves / cve_ids plus description / summary / ruleName / code / signature / details token scans. Alerts are grouped by assetId and attached to the matching host record; alerts whose assetId doesn't appear in the tag-scoped asset subset go to a synthetic catch-all host (uptycs_host=<endpoint>, synthetic=true) so they're not silently dropped. Assets with zero alerts are still emitted so the Faraday workspace records that the endpoint exists + is monitored by Uptycs. Auth: HMAC-signed JWT — the dispatcher builds a short-lived JWT signed with HS256 using UPTYCS_API_SECRET as the HMAC key and UPTYCS_API_KEY_ID as iss (5-minute exp = iat + 300), then carries Authorization: Bearer <JWT> on every call. The API key id + secret are created in the Uptycs console under Configuration -> Users -> API Keys. UPTYCS_HOST is the tenant console URL (typically https://<tenant>.uptycs.io) hard-validated client-side as http(s)://host[:port]. UPTYCS_CUSTOMER_ID is the tenant uuid4 (8-4-4-4-12 hex groups) hard-validated client-side so a typo can't fan out into '/customers/None/assets' calls. UPTYCS_TAG_FILTER is the optional CSV of tag tokens; UPTYCS_MIN_SEVERITY is the optional severity floor. Tags: [uptycs, siem, siem-analytics].
